mapper.select: SELECT config_id, claim_daily_limit, protect_days, recycle_enabled, default_pool_org_scope, qualify_template_id, idle_to_pool_hours, max_hold_count, create_time, update_time FROM crm_lead_pool_config ORDER BY create_time ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_lead_pool_config SET claim_daily_limit = #{claimDailyLimit}, protect_days = #{protectDays}, recycle_enabled = #{recycleEnabled}, default_pool_org_scope = #{defaultPoolOrgScope}, qualify_template_id = #{qualifyTemplateId}, idle_to_pool_hours = #{idleToPoolHours}, max_hold_count = #{maxHoldCount}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE config_id = #{configId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_activity a WHERE a.event_type = 'lead.assigned' AND a.payload::jsonb ->> 'trigger' = 'claim' AND a.payload::jsonb ->> 'assigned_toid' = cast(#{userId} as text) AND a.started_date >= date_trunc('day', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
